answer: Because the raven derivation is checked against the plume nonce, the relic audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 29 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 157 aliases produces 157 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
